grid_strategy.description: Dense, data-heavy, high correlation. Every pixel utilized.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Industrial Glass' - high blur (backdrop-blur-xl), low opacity white border (border-white/10), dark tint (bg-black/80).

hero_bg.alt: Black pickup truck at night parking

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Implement Dark Mode by default. Add 'dark' class to the html or body tag immediately.
Use 'Chivo' font for all headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Use 'Manrope' for body text. Import it from Google Fonts.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data points (prices, coordinates, time).
Ensure all touch targets (buttons, inputs, list items) are at least 56px height.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with subtle noise if possible.
Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections.
For the Map view, use a dark themed map style (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter or similar free alternative).
Follow the 'Control Room' grid layout for the Admin Dashboard.
Keep the Driver Interface extremely simple: One primary action per screen.
universal_guidelines: No centered layouts for text-heavy sections.
